test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters, that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

R _ M _ _ H _ B R H M _ _ H M B

options.text: R B H M B R
H R B M B R
H B R M B M
H B R M B R

solution:
Given: R _ M _ _ H _ B R H M _ _ H M B

1) R B H M B R → R **R** M **B -** **H** H **M** B - R H M **M -** **R** H M B

2) H R B M B R → R **H** M **R -** **B** H **M** B - R H M **B** - **R** H M B
